signin.title: Pocket Money
signin.tagline: A family pocket-money ledger that lives in your own Google Sheet.

bootstrap.noFamilyHint: Create a new family, or open a sheet another parent shared with you. Invited? Use the link from the invitation email, or choose Open existing and pick the shared sheet under "Shared with me".

bootstrap.joinHint: Confirm the shared sheet in the next step to give this app access to it.

settings.membersHint: Parents can edit. Kid viewers see everything but cannot change anything.

settings.inviteLinkHint: Send this link to the person you invited. They sign in with Google and confirm the shared sheet once.
